readmeExcerpt: This lab connects a small Spring Boot app to Oracle AI Database Free using UCP and the JDBC observability provider. Grafana LGTM receives application/JDBC traces, correlated Logback logs, HTTP/JVM/UCP metrics, and database metrics. Database-native span export is configured through `DBMS_OBSERVABILITY` and an HTTPS proxy (The database spans require HTTPS, hence the proxy for local Grafana LGTM).
metaTitle: Observability with Oracle AI Database | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Observe Spring Boot and optional ORDS requests to Oracle AI Database with JDBC traces, UCP and database metrics, correlated logs, and Grafana LGTM.
